scientific_interpretation: The static test-definition count equals the unittest discover count on the laboratory's own test suite. This is a count-only smoke test, not an identity-level guarantee of runtime test collection.
limitations: Only first-party lab test suite was scanned. No third-party suite has been indexed.
Static candidate definitions do not guarantee executable tests.
Parametrized or dynamically generated tests cannot be counted by this inventory.
Inherited or plugin-created cases may be missed.
Several definitions may be collected differently by pytest/unittest configurations; count equality is not a proof of identity.
No bug finding or test-selection policy comparison performed.
next_steps: Assess candidate-identity agreement with actual isolated test discovery, without using defect results to select tests.
Prepare pre-registered multi-project benchmark excluding known PySnooper/tqdm calibration bugs.
Freeze policies and resource budgets before any new external bug scoring.
